author: Yffe
content: Failing tests at forge/tests/divergence_noliteral_spec_arith.rs::literal_free_arith_spec_fn_certifies_l3 and ::literal_free_two_param_arith_spec_fn_certifies_l3 demonstrate the divergence (run with --ignored; both assert design-§6 L3, both observe L0 with E0308 'expected u64, found int' on the bare 'n + n' / 'a + b' result). Root cause: block_result_is_int_literal_arith requires expr_mentions_int_literal, but Verus types ALL spec arithmetic as int — the literal mention is incidental to the #237 repro, not the typing trigger. Fail-closed (no false certification). Also adjudicated this re-audit: the #237 narrowing is NOT a soundness change — live probe shows an out-of-range narrowed value is OPAQUE to verus (postcondition 'result == big(0)' with big = (u64::MAX + 1) as u64 and body 0 FAILS, i.e. no silent-wrap certification; truncating semantics would have certified it).
